notes: ἐκ δευτέρου: the ASV spreads the phrase over separate words, so rule 94 forbids one compound unit and ἐκ is left unrepresented under rule 34, no English word answering to it.
'for' in 'wait for him' kept with the participle as the English verb's own particle, no Greek preposition standing to answer to it (rule 36's contrast).
οὕτως keeps 'so' whole and the separate καί takes the 'also' the ASV writes for it (rule 100).
